title: Araylim · Revision — Homework
headline: The Science Project
intro: Read the story and answer the questions. Practice your present and past tenses!

paragraphs.label: A.
paragraphs.text: Last month, Araylim had a big challenge. Her science teacher asked the class to build a small robot. Araylim had never built a robot before, so she felt nervous. But she decided to try her best. She spent many hours reading books and watching videos about robots.

paragraphs.label: B.
paragraphs.text: While she was building the robot, she made a few mistakes. Once, she connected the wrong wire and the robot did not move. However, she did not give up. She asked her father for help, and he showed her how to fix it. They worked together for three days.

paragraphs.label: C.
paragraphs.text: Finally, the robot was finished. When Araylim presented it in class, the robot walked across the table! The teacher was very impressed and gave her an A. Araylim has learned that hard work and practice always lead to success.
